title: Gumba
description: Ngweṋa, Tshibode, Phengwini na Khuhu zwo wana gumba. Ndi gumba ḽazwo naa? ‘Gumba ḽashu,’ hu amba mme na baba nga u ḓihudza mafhedziseloni. Wanani uri ndi gumba ḽa nnyi.
